independent.thesis: External source-model probability exceeds all-in asks.

consistency.thesis: Same verified binary condition: combined two-token acquisition below unit payout. Partial-leg exposure retained.

momentum.thesis: Past-only 30–120s midpoint drift persists; pricing target, not independent event probability.

spread_capture.thesis: A resting bid can enter only when subsequent observed asks cross it; adverse selection may dominate spread.
spread_capture.exit: executable bid covers round-trip costs or120s timeout

event_repricing.thesis: New external-source probability revision precedes market adjustment.
